title: The downloaded file is not the one this release lists
body: The installer downloaded cheetah-test.260101.001-factory-31c2322a.zip from Google's server, and the file is not what the release's signed list of Google's builds says: its SHA-256 is another than the one the list records for build TEST.260101.001.
The installer uses nothing of that file, and what it had downloaded of it is deleted from this computer.

Starting the installer again downloads the file afresh. If it stops here again, Google's file and this release's list do not agree: please tell us at https://github.com/derekross/omarchy-mobile/issues
footer: The installer only asked the phone what it is. It has written nothing to it.
You can start the installer again at any time.
